findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_entity_profile, get_digest, draft_reply, get_trends · Private data: get_health, get_pricing, research_mentions, compare_brands, get_digest, detect_risk, draft_reply, list_mentions, get_trends · Public sink: get_pricing, research_mentions, compare_brands, get_digest, detect_risk, draft_reply, list_mentions, get_trends · Destructive: get_health, get_pricing, get_entity_profile, draft_reply.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_entity_profile, get_digest, draft_reply, get_trends · Private data: get_health, get_pricing, research_mentions, compare_brands, get_digest, detect_risk, draft_reply, list_mentions, get_trends · Public sink: get_pricing, research_mentions, compare_brands, get_digest, detect_risk, draft_reply, list_mentions, get_trends · Destructive: get_health, get_pricing, get_entity_profile, draft_reply

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
